s0101.literal: On guimao day the moon transgressed Fang.
s0101.idiomatic: On guimao day the moon transgressed Fang.

s0102.literal: On jiachen day the moon transgressed Celestial River.
s0102.idiomatic: On jiachen day the moon transgressed Celestial River.

s0103.literal: An edict ordered boundary demarcation of garrison colony fields of all guards.
s0103.idiomatic: An edict ordered boundary demarcation of garrison colony fields of all guards.

s0104.literal: Mianyang, Guide, Runing, Anfeng, and other places suffered famine; grain was issued to relieve them.
s0104.idiomatic: Mianyang, Guide, Runing, Anfeng, and other places suffered famine; grain was issued to relieve them.

s0105.literal: Second year, spring, first month, on yimao day Jupiter transgressed Ghost.
s0105.idiomatic: Second year, spring, first month, on yimao day Jupiter transgressed Ghost.

s0106.literal: On wuwu day Huaimeng, Weihui, and other places suffered famine; grain was issued to relieve them.
s0106.idiomatic: On wuwu day Huaimeng, Weihui, and other places suffered famine; grain was issued to relieve them.

s0107.literal: On jiwei day Venus appeared in the daytime.
s0107.idiomatic: On jiwei day Venus appeared in the daytime.

s0108.literal: On guihai day the moon transgressed Xuanyuan.
s0108.idiomatic: On guihai day the moon transgressed Xuanyuan.

s0109.literal: On bingyin day prolonged rain destroyed Hun River dikes and weirs, inundating civilian fields; troops were dispatched to repair them.
s0109.idiomatic: On bingyin day prolonged rain destroyed Hun River dikes and weirs, inundating civilian fields; troops were dispatched to repair them.

s0110.literal: Private iron smelting by the people was forbidden.
s0110.idiomatic: Private iron smelting by the people was forbidden.

s0111.literal: Troops were dispatched to dredge the Huozhou canal transport river.
s0111.idiomatic: Troops were dispatched to dredge the Huozhou canal transport river.

s0112.literal: On dingmao day the moon transgressed Jinxian.
s0112.idiomatic: On dingmao day the moon transgressed Jinxian.

s0113.literal: On wuchen day the people of Jinning and other places suffered famine; notes were granted to relieve them.
s0113.idiomatic: On wuchen day the people of Jinning and other places suffered famine; notes were granted to relieve them.

s0114.literal: On jisi day the Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Temple Directorate-General was established, rank primary third grade.
s0114.idiomatic: On jisi day the Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Temple Directorate-General was established, rank primary third grade.

s0115.literal: On gengwu day a circulating treasury was established at Jiangyin Prefecture.
s0115.idiomatic: On gengwu day a circulating treasury was established at Jiangyin Prefecture.

s0116.literal: An edict ordered that penalty-fine notes from the Jiangnan branch secretariat be used to relieve and succor famine-stricken people.
s0116.idiomatic: An edict ordered that penalty-fine notes from the Jiangnan branch secretariat be used to relieve and succor famine-stricken people.

s0117.literal: On yihai day an edict dispatched pacification commissioners to twelve circuits to inquire into the people's sufferings, demote and promote officials, and grant silver seals to each.
s0117.idiomatic: On yihai day an edict dispatched pacification commissioners to twelve circuits to inquire into the people's sufferings, demote and promote officials, and grant silver seals to each.

s0118.literal: Central secretariat ministers were ordered to divide supervision of routine affairs.
s0118.idiomatic: Central secretariat ministers were ordered to divide supervision of routine affairs.

s0119.literal: Southerners were forbidden to pawn wives and children and sell them as bonded servants.
s0119.idiomatic: Southerners were forbidden to pawn wives and children and sell them as bonded servants.

s0120.literal: Censorate officials memorialized, saying, "In recent years earthquakes, floods, and droughts have caused the people to flee and banditry to rise — all because surveillance oversight has been constrained by fears and failed in investigation, chancellors' harmonizing governance has fallen short, close attendants have obscured matters, rewards and punishments have been improper, prisons have held wrongful and excessive cases, and taxes and corvée have been heavy — leading to disharmony.
s0120.idiomatic: Censorate officials memorialized, saying, "In recent years earthquakes, floods, and droughts have caused the people to flee and banditry to rise — all because surveillance oversight has been constrained by fears and failed in investigation, chancellors' harmonizing governance has fallen short, close attendants have obscured matters, rewards and punishments have been improper, prisons have held wrongful and excessive cases, and taxes and corvée have been heavy — leading to disharmony.

s0121.literal: It is fitting to deliberate with mature and seasoned men on the causes."
s0121.idiomatic: It is fitting to deliberate with mature and seasoned men on the causes."

s0122.literal: An edict directed that the specific measures that should be carried out be clearly stated and reported.
s0122.idiomatic: An edict directed that the specific measures that should be carried out be clearly stated and reported.

s0123.literal: Prince Teliq Temür's department lacked food; seven thousand five hundred ingots of notes were granted to them.
s0123.idiomatic: Prince Teliq Temür's department lacked food; 7,500 ingots of notes were granted to them.

s0124.literal: The people of Yidu, Banyang, and Jinning suffered famine; notes and grain were granted to relieve them.
s0124.idiomatic: The people of Yidu, Banyang, and Jinning suffered famine; notes and grain were granted to relieve them.

s0125.literal: Second month, on yimao new moon, the metropolitan examination for jinshi candidates was held.
s0125.idiomatic: Second month, on yimao new moon, the metropolitan examination for jinshi candidates was held.

s0126.literal: On wuzi day Venus appeared in the daytime.
s0126.idiomatic: On wuzi day Venus appeared in the daytime.

s0127.literal: On guisi day Venus crossed the meridian.
s0127.idiomatic: On guisi day Venus crossed the meridian.

s0128.literal: On jiawu day an edict forbade the people from reselling adopted sons.
s0128.idiomatic: On jiawu day an edict forbade the people from reselling adopted sons.

s0129.literal: On bingshen day Prince Nahu Dar was granted fifty taels of gold, two hundred fifty taels of silver, and five hundred ingots of notes.
s0129.idiomatic: On bingshen day Prince Nahu Dar was granted 50 taels of gold, 250 taels of silver, and 500 ingots of notes.

s0130.literal: On gengzi day an edict appointed Gonggarogros Jancang Pakba as Imperial Preceptor, granted a jade seal, and still proclaimed it throughout the realm.
s0130.idiomatic: On gengzi day an edict appointed Gonggarogros Jancang Pakba as Imperial Preceptor, granted a jade seal, and still proclaimed it throughout the realm.

s0131.literal: On renyin day Prince Laodi of Yunnan came to court.
s0131.idiomatic: On renyin day Prince Laodi of Yunnan came to court.

s0132.literal: Chen and Yuan cave barbarian Wu Qiandao acted as bandit; an edict ordered troops mobilized to capture him.
s0132.idiomatic: Chen and Yuan cave barbarian Wu Qiandao acted as bandit; an edict ordered troops mobilized to capture him.

s0133.literal: On yisi day Prince Yölü Temür was granted ten thousand ingots of notes.
s0133.idiomatic: On yisi day Prince Yölü Temür was granted 10,000 ingots of notes.

s0134.literal: On bingwu day Venus crossed the meridian.
s0134.idiomatic: On bingwu day Venus crossed the meridian.

s0135.literal: That month Jinning, Xuande, and other places suffered famine; grain and notes were granted to relieve them.
s0135.idiomatic: That month Jinning, Xuande, and other places suffered famine; grain and notes were granted to relieve them.

s0136.literal: Zhenzhou Yangzi County suffered fire; grain was issued and sold at reduced prices for relief.
s0136.idiomatic: Zhenzhou Yangzi County suffered fire; grain was issued and sold at reduced prices for relief.

s0137.literal: Third month, on yimao day the palace examination for jinshi candidates was held; Hudu Dar, Zhang Qiyan, and fifty-six others in all were granted jinshi degrees and secondary ranks in varying degrees.
s0137.idiomatic: Third month, on yimao day the palace examination for jinshi candidates was held; Hudu Dar, Zhang Qiyan, and 56 others in all were granted jinshi degrees and secondary ranks in varying degrees.

s0138.literal: On bingchen day the moon's color was like ochre.
s0138.idiomatic: On bingchen day the moon's color was like ochre.

s0139.literal: On gengwu day the Emperor led princes and officials in presenting jade registers and a jade seal, adding an honorific title to the empress dowager; an edict proclaimed remission of overdue taxes and levies throughout the realm.
s0139.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Emperor led princes and officials in presenting jade registers and a jade seal, adding an honorific title to the empress dowager; an edict proclaimed remission of overdue taxes and levies throughout the realm.

s0140.literal: On dingchou day Central Secretariat Associate Administrator Zhang Lü was made Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat Grand Councillor.
s0140.idiomatic: On dingchou day central secretariat associate administrator Zhang Lü was made Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor.

s0141.literal: Summer, fourth month, on wuyin new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
s0141.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on wuyin new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

s0142.literal: On xinsi day the honorary banquet for jinshi graduates was granted at the Hanlin Academy.
s0142.idiomatic: On xinsi day the honorary banquet for jinshi graduates was granted at the Hanlin Academy.

s0143.literal: On guisi day an edict directed that among expeditionary troops of Isdan and other departments, those who were late or who fled and returned were all to be beheaded as a warning.
s0143.idiomatic: On guisi day an edict directed that among expeditionary troops of Isdan and other departments, those who were late or who fled and returned were all to be beheaded as a warning.

s0144.literal: On jiawu day Prince of Jin Yesun Temür was instructed to return the Huizhou silver mine cave granted in the former reign to the relevant office.
s0144.idiomatic: On jiawu day Prince of Jin Yesun Temür was instructed to return the Huizhou silver mine cave granted in the former reign to the relevant office.

s0145.literal: On gengzi day the moon transgressed Encampment.
s0145.idiomatic: On gengzi day the moon transgressed Encampment.

s0146.literal: On xinchou day metropolitan examination candidates who failed the examination and were aged seventy or above were granted retirement as seventh-rank flowing officials; those sixty or above were made prefectural and district instructors; the remainder were all appointed mountain wardens and academy rectifiers — later cases shall not cite this as precedent.
s0146.idiomatic: On xinchou day metropolitan examination candidates who failed the examination and were aged 70 or above were granted retirement as seventh-rank flowing officials; those 60 or above were made prefectural and district instructors; the remainder were all appointed mountain wardens and academy rectifiers — later cases shall not cite this as precedent.

s0147.literal: An edict directed that in princely appanages regular officials should still serve as darughachi, and those appointed by each fief should serve as vice darughachi.
s0147.idiomatic: An edict directed that in princely appanages regular officials should still serve as darughachi, and those appointed by each fief should serve as vice darughachi.

s0148.literal: Li Meng and others were ordered to compile and classify successive reigns' statutes and regulations; when the book was complete, they were to report and promulgate it.
s0148.idiomatic: Li Meng and others were ordered to compile and classify successive reigns' statutes and regulations; when the book was complete, they were to report and promulgate it.

s0149.literal: The Regulations Transport Inspection Office was established, rank fifth grade, with four officials;
s0149.idiomatic: The Regulations Transport Inspection Office was established, rank fifth grade, with four officials;

s0150.literal: the Broad Storage Treasury, rank seventh grade, with three officials;
s0150.idiomatic: the Broad Storage Treasury, rank seventh grade, with three officials;

s0151.literal: both subordinate to the Longevity and Blessings Court.
s0151.idiomatic: both subordinate to the Longevity and Blessings Court.

s0152.literal: On yisi day the imperial carriage proceeded to the Upper Capital.
s0152.idiomatic: On yisi day the imperial carriage proceeded to the Upper Capital.

s0153.literal: The Palace Domestic Service, to supply imperial meals, dispatched men to hunt at Guide; an edict, because they disturbed the people, specially abolished it.
s0153.idiomatic: The palace domestic service, to supply imperial meals, dispatched men to hunt at Guide; an edict, because they disturbed the people, specially abolished it.

s0154.literal: Specially appointed Superior Prelate and Grand Master of the Mysterious Teaching Zhang Liusun was additionally granted Grand Master with the Same Ceremonial Standing as the Three Excellencies.
s0154.idiomatic: Specially appointed superior prelate and grand master of the Mysterious Teaching Zhang Liusun was additionally granted grand master with the same ceremonial standing as the Three Excellencies.

s0155.literal: On bingwu day Prince Chaba'er was enfeoffed Prince of Runing.
s0155.idiomatic: On bingwu day Prince Chaba'er was enfeoffed Prince of Runing.

s0156.literal: Tanzhou, Jiangzhou, Jianchang, and Yuanzhou suffered famine; granary grain was issued and sold at reduced prices for relief.
s0156.idiomatic: Tanzhou, Jiangzhou, Jianchang, and Yuanzhou suffered famine; granary grain was issued and sold at reduced prices for relief.

s0157.literal: Fifth month, on wushen new moon, silver seals for surveillance commissions of each circuit were changed and reissued; the Shaanxi Branch Censorate was re-established.
s0157.idiomatic: Fifth month, on wushen new moon, silver seals for surveillance commissions of each circuit were changed and reissued; the Shaanxi branch censorate was re-established.

s0158.literal: Guichi Zhang Xiaosi and others had recruited six thousand households; they were compelled to return to civilian registers.
s0158.idiomatic: Guichi Zhang Xiaosi and others had recruited 6,000 households; they were compelled to return to civilian registers.

s0159.literal: Censor-in-Chief Wang Yi requested leave to return home and care for his parents; it was not permitted.
s0159.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Wang Yi requested leave to return home and care for his parents; it was not permitted.

s0160.literal: On gengshen day Princess Yan Haiya was granted one thousand ingots of notes.
s0160.idiomatic: On gengshen day Princess Yan Haiya was granted 1,000 ingots of notes.

s0161.literal: On xinyou day the moon transgressed Celestial River.
s0161.idiomatic: On xinyou day the moon transgressed Celestial River.

s0162.literal: On yichou day in Chengji County, Qinzhou, a mountain moved.
s0162.idiomatic: On yichou day in Chengji County, Qinzhou, a mountain moved.

s0163.literal: That night fierce wind, lightning, and hail struck; a northern mountain moved southward to the river by evening; the next day it moved again; on level ground earthen mounds protruded, some two or three zhang high, burying and inundating people's dwellings.
s0163.idiomatic: That night fierce wind, lightning, and hail struck; a northern mountain moved southward to the river by evening; the next day it moved again; on level ground earthen mounds protruded, some two or three zhang high, burying and inundating people's dwellings.

s0164.literal: An edict dispatched officials to verify and provide relief.
s0164.idiomatic: An edict dispatched officials to verify and provide relief.

s0165.literal: On gengwu day Venus appeared in the daytime.
s0165.idiomatic: On gengwu day Venus appeared in the daytime.

s0166.literal: The Western Sea and Liaodong Falconry Ten-Thousand Households Office was established, subordinate to the Central Administration Court.
s0166.idiomatic: The Western Sea and Liaodong Falconry Ten-Thousand Households Office was established, subordinate to the Central Administration Court.

s0167.literal: On renshen day Prince Saduseri died.
s0167.idiomatic: On renshen day Prince Saduseri died.

s0168.literal: On jiaxu day the sun's color was like ochre.
s0168.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the sun's color was like ochre.

s0169.literal: Eunuch Central Palace Director Xu Yuanhui was additionally granted Academician of the Broad Literature Hall.
s0169.idiomatic: Eunuch central palace director Xu Yuanhui was additionally granted academician of the Broad Literature Hall.

s0170.literal: On yihai day the sun's color was like ochre.
s0170.idiomatic: On yihai day the sun's color was like ochre.

s0171.literal: That month three hundred shi of grain were issued to relieve the poor among Prince Ante Temür and other departments.
s0171.idiomatic: That month 300 shi of grain were issued to relieve the poor among Prince Ante Temür and other departments.

s0172.literal: Fengyuan, Longxing, Ji'an, Nankang, Linjiang, Yuanzhou, Fuzhou, Jiangzhou, Jianchang, Ganzhou, Nan'an, Meizhou, Chenzhou, Xingguo, Tanzhou, Yuezhou, Changde, Wuchang, and other routes, Nanfeng Prefecture, Li Prefecture, and other places suffered famine; granary grain was issued and sold at reduced prices for relief in all cases.
s0172.idiomatic: Fengyuan, Longxing, Ji'an, Nankang, Linjiang, Yuanzhou, Fuzhou, Jiangzhou, Jianchang, Ganzhou, Nan'an, Meizhou, Chenzhou, Xingguo, Tanzhou, Yuezhou, Changde, Wuchang, and other routes, Nanfeng Prefecture, Li Prefecture, and other places suffered famine; granary grain was issued and sold at reduced prices for relief in all cases.

s0173.literal: Sixth month, on xinsi day the relay stations at Chaghan Na'ur lacked food; grain was granted to relieve them.
s0173.idiomatic: Sixth month, on xinsi day the relay stations at Chaghan Na'ur lacked food; grain was granted to relieve them.

s0174.literal: On jiashen day Venus appeared in the daytime; that night the moon transgressed Pingdao.
s0174.idiomatic: On jiashen day Venus appeared in the daytime; that night the moon transgressed Pingdao.

s0175.literal: On yiwei day the Shaanxi Surveillance Commission was moved to Fengxiang.
s0175.idiomatic: On yiwei day the Shaanxi surveillance commission was moved to Fengxiang.

s0176.literal: On wuxu day Prince Bin Nanhuli and other departments were destitute; notes were granted so they could buy horses and sheep to sustain themselves.
s0176.idiomatic: On wuxu day Prince Bin Nanhuli and other departments were destitute; notes were granted so they could buy horses and sheep to sustain themselves.

s0177.literal: The Yellow River breached its banks at Zhengzhou.
s0177.idiomatic: The Yellow River breached its banks at Zhengzhou.

s0178.literal: On jihai day tutorship posts for Prince of Runing Chaba'er were established.
s0178.idiomatic: On jihai day tutorship posts for Prince of Runing Chaba'er were established.

s0179.literal: On xinchou day because Jining and Yidu suffered severe drought, palace guard fodder and grain were reduced.
s0179.idiomatic: On xinchou day because Jining and Yidu suffered severe drought, palace guard fodder and grain were reduced.

s0180.literal: On guimao day Venus transgressed Well.
s0180.idiomatic: On guimao day Venus transgressed Well.

s0181.literal: On bingwu day Mercury transgressed Ghost.
s0181.idiomatic: On bingwu day Mercury transgressed Ghost.

s0182.literal: The king of Burma sent his son Tekathai and others to present tribute goods.
s0182.idiomatic: The king of Burma sent his son Tekathai and others to present tribute goods.

s0183.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on gengxu day one assistant intendant was added to Xinghe Route.
s0183.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on gengxu day one assistant intendant was added to Xinghe Route.

s0184.literal: On wushen day Prince Xuanning Temurbuqa and his two younger brothers were granted ten thousand ingots of notes, together with jade fittings, saddles and bridles, and silks and cloths.
s0184.idiomatic: On wushen day Prince Xuanning Temurbuqa and his two younger brothers were granted 10,000 ingots of notes, together with jade fittings, saddles and bridles, and silks and cloths.

s0185.literal: On renzi day Palace Provision Office posts were increased from six to eight; the Cloud Supply Directorate-General added two associate directors.
s0185.idiomatic: On renzi day palace provision office posts were increased from six to eight; the Cloud Supply directorate-general added two associate directors.

s0186.literal: On guichou day the Huizhou silver and iron cave was again granted to Prince of Jin Yesun Temür.
s0186.idiomatic: On guichou day the Huizhou silver and iron cave was again granted to Prince of Jin Yesun Temür.

s0187.literal: On jiayin day four tutorship posts for Prince Olawtumsun were established; Chenzhou Shangshui Town was restored as Nandun County; four officials of the Two Huai Garrison Colony Directorate-General were cut; the transport office was merged into the intendant commission; the Zhiga Baraqson Directorate-General was changed to the Imperial Provision Office.
s0187.idiomatic: On jiayin day four tutorship posts for Prince Olawtumsun were established; Chenzhou Shangshui Town was restored as Nandun County; four officials of the Two Huai garrison colony directorate-general were cut; the transport office was merged into the intendant commission; the Zhiga Baraqson directorate-general was changed to the imperial provision office.

s0188.literal: On yimao day Ganzhou native bandit Cai Wujiu gathered a crowd and raised disorder; an edict ordered troops dispatched to capture him.
s0188.idiomatic: On yimao day Ganzhou native bandit Cai Wujiu gathered a crowd and raised disorder; an edict ordered troops dispatched to capture him.

s0189.literal: An edict directed that impoverished Asud Guard households be given oxen, seed, and farming implements and garrison-colonized at Qanchari.
s0189.idiomatic: An edict directed that impoverished Asud Guard households be given oxen, seed, and farming implements and garrison-colonized at Qanchari.

s0190.literal: On jiazi day Jiangnan-Huguang Circuit envoy Wendihan memorialized, saying, "Surveillance commission public fields take too much from the people's rent — the former system should be restored.
s0190.idiomatic: On jiazi day Jiangnan-Huguang Circuit envoy Wendihan memorialized, saying, "Surveillance commission public fields take too much from the people's rent — the former system should be restored.

s0192.literal: On yichou day the rank of the Chongfu Court was raised to primary second grade.
s0192.idiomatic: On yichou day the rank of the Chongfu Court was raised to primary second grade.

s0193.literal: On guiyou day Prince Wei Amuge was granted ten thousand ingots of notes.
s0193.idiomatic: On guiyou day Prince Wei Amuge was granted 10,000 ingots of notes.

s0194.literal: Temüder was ordered to take overall charge of Buddhist Administration Court affairs; an edict instructed the court and the realm.
s0194.idiomatic: Temüder was ordered to take overall charge of Buddhist Administration Court affairs; an edict instructed the court and the realm.

s0195.literal: That month within the capital region there was heavy rain; Huozhou, Changping, Xianghe, Baodi, and other counties suffered flooding that inundated civilian fields and dwellings;
s0195.idiomatic: That month within the capital region there was heavy rain; Huozhou, Changping, Xianghe, Baodi, and other counties suffered flooding that inundated civilian fields and dwellings;

s0196.literal: Tanzhou, Quanzhou, Yongzhou Route, Chaling Prefecture suffered prolonged rain; the rivers rose and inundated the crops; grain was issued and sold at reduced prices for relief.
s0196.idiomatic: Tanzhou, Quanzhou, Yongzhou Route, Chaling Prefecture suffered prolonged rain; the rivers rose and inundated the crops; grain was issued and sold at reduced prices for relief.

s0197.literal: Eighth month, on bingxu day Ganzhou bandit Cai Wujiu took Tingzhou Ninghua County and presumptuously declared himself king; an edict dispatched Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat Grand Councillor Zhang Lü and others to lead troops to suppress him.
s0197.idiomatic: Eighth month, on bingxu day Ganzhou bandit Cai Wujiu took Tingzhou Ninghua County and presumptuously declared himself king; an edict dispatched Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor Zhang Lü and others to lead troops to suppress him.

s0198.literal: On jichou day the imperial carriage returned from the Upper Capital.
s0198.idiomatic: On jichou day the imperial carriage returned from the Upper Capital.

s0199.literal: On yiwei day censorate officials memorialized, saying, "Cai Wujiu's rebellion was entirely caused by Nizam al-Din's administration of field and grain surveys, together with prefectures and counties imposing extreme cruelty — driving the people to this extremity.
s0199.idiomatic: On yiwei day censorate officials memorialized, saying, "Cai Wujiu's rebellion was entirely caused by Nizam al-Din's administration of field and grain surveys, together with prefectures and counties imposing extreme cruelty — driving the people to this extremity.

s0200.literal: In Xinping County alone, one thousand nine hundred households' dwellings were demolished, graves were leveled and bones exposed, acreage was falsely inflated, and poison spread among the residents; we request abolition of the field survey and cancellation of falsely expanded land rents."
s0200.idiomatic: In Xinping County alone, 1,900 households' dwellings were demolished, graves were leveled and bones exposed, acreage was falsely inflated, and poison spread among the residents; we request abolition of the field survey and cancellation of falsely expanded land rents."
